_comment: OF28: per-species shiny REPAINT rules, consumed by tools/repaint_creature_textures.py. Owner directive 2026-08-15: shinies are genuinely different colourways, never a tint -- 'if our newt is blue, I want red. not blue with a red shade over it. for the white and black striped badger maybe it becomes blue stripes.' Rules are HSV region remaps (first match wins per pixel); value/texture detail is preserved so the repaint reads as the same painted surface in a new colourway. All numbers tunable. Regenerate with: python3 tools/repaint_creature_textures.py
_comment_pilots: paddlenewt and burrowback are the owner's own named examples and the pilot pair; the rest of the roster gets colourways after the pilots pass a render judge.

paddlenewt._comment: Base: teal body, cream/tan belly plates, salmon accents, gold spots + eyes. Shiny: the owner's red newt -- teal goes deep ember red, salmon accents go molten gold so they still read as separate markings, cream and gold stay put.

burrowback._comment: Base: charcoal-black fur, off-white/cream stripe patches, grey stone plates. Shiny: the owner's blue-striped badger -- the pale patches saturate to a clear cornflower blue, the near-black fur cools toward blue-black, the grey plates pick up a slate-blue cast.

terrapup._comment: Base: amber/brown pup, mostly dark. Shiny: frost pup -- ambers go slate blue, the darks cool.

ripplet._comment: Base: bright teal water sprite. Shiny: sunset coral.

galewisp._comment: Base: pale cyan + soft yellow, airy. Shiny: lavender-violet wisp; the yellows go pale gold-white.

meadowhart._comment: Base: golden-tan deer. Shiny: pale silver spirit-hart -- the golds desaturate to moonlight with a cool cast.

tuskroot._comment: Base: dark earth-brown boar. Shiny: deep jade -- the browns go mossy green, keeping the dark mass.

mosshell._comment: Base: green/yellow-green turtle. Shiny: autumn -- the greens turn ember orange-red.

brooktail._comment: Base: warm brown otter. Shiny: midnight indigo with the same markings.

galecrest._comment: Base: rust red-orange raptor. Shiny: storm-white -- the rusts bleach to pale ice blue, reading as a white bird at distance.

duskhush._comment: Base: grey-teal nocturne. Shiny: deep plum-magenta night creature.

pipwing._comment: Base: sunny yellow songbird. Shiny: sky-blue.

reedwing._comment: Base: mixed teal/green/straw wader. Shiny: flamingo -- the cools go pink, the straws go warm gold.

bramblebun._comment: Embedded-texture species (extracted from the glb by the tool). Base: golden bunny. Shiny: mint-green.

mudsnout._comment: Embedded-texture species. Base: mud-brown snuffler. Shiny: rosy pink piglet.

trailpup._comment: Embedded-texture species. Base: sandy tan pup. Shiny: russet fox-red.

veridian._comment: Embedded-texture species. Base: leaf green. Shiny: amber-gold.
